description: Prepare repaying Midnight debt at face value, withdrawing collateral, or both, in one MidnightBundlesV2 transaction. First call `morpho_midnight_get_user_position` for the debt and collateral. To repay at the book price before maturity, use `morpho_prepare_midnight_take_repay_withdraw_collateral`. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

collateralAmount.description: Collateral token amount to withdraw, in human-readable decimals, or "max" for the full balance. Omit to only repay.

collateralIndex.description: Index of the collateral in the market `collaterals` list

marketId.description: Midnight market ID (`market_id` from the Midnight read tools)

repayAmount.description: Loan token amount to repay, in human-readable decimals, or "max" to repay all debt. "0" only withdraws collateral.

userAddress.description: Account that sends the transactions and owns the position

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_repay_withdraw_collateral
